# `<sl-sidebar-group>` — Sidebar Group

> **Only in Saipem DS.** This component does not exist in upstream Shoelace or Web Awesome: use only the API below.

Sidebar groups are titled sections of a [sidebar](sidebar.md) that hold sidebar items.

**Status:** experimental · **Since:** 2.20

**Import:** `import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/sidebar-group/sidebar-group.js';`

**Uses internally (registered automatically):** `<sl-badge>`, `<sl-divider>`, `<sl-tooltip>`

## Attributes

Every attribute is also a property (camelCase name in the second column when it differs). Boolean attributes are on when present: never write `="false"`, remove the attribute or bind the property instead.

| Attribute | Property | Type / allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | — | `string` | `''` | The group's title. |
| `count` | — | `string \| undefined` | — | An optional count shown at the end of the header, e.g. the total of the group's items. |
| `collapsed` | — | `boolean` | `false` | Set by the parent `<sl-sidebar>`. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | The group's items, usually `<sl-sidebar-item>` elements. |
| `icon` | An icon shown next to the label. It's the only thing visible when the sidebar is collapsed. |

## CSS parts

Parts exist for fine adjustments. Do not use them to change colours, borders or fonts: a missing look is a missing variant of the DS.

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `base` | The component's base wrapper. |
| `header` | The row holding icon, label and count. |
| `icon` | The icon tile. |
| `label` | The group's label. |
| `count` | The group's count, an `<sl-badge>`. |
| `items` | The container of the group's items. |
| `divider` | The `<sl-divider>` separating this group from the next one. |

## CSS custom properties

| Property | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--icon-size` | — | The size of the icon tile. Items align their labels past it. |

## Documentation and examples

Used inside [`sl-sidebar`](sidebar.md). See the sidebar page for full examples.

```html
<sl-sidebar no-toggle style="--width: 20rem; height: auto;">
  <sl-sidebar-group label="Procurement (SAP)" count="71">
    <sl-icon slot="icon" name="cart"></sl-icon>
    <sl-sidebar-item href="#" count="13" current>Purchase Request</sl-sidebar-item>
    <sl-sidebar-item href="#" count="18">Purchase Order</sl-sidebar-item>
  </sl-sidebar-group>
</sl-sidebar>
```
